value.rationale: This computes the exact sharp worst-case endpoint amplification of a canonical full rank-one symmetric frequency cone for every odd field and dimension. Its signed-type correction and positive, parity-dependent finite-size asymptotic quantify the departure from the universal limiting constant, a natural stability invariant not obtained from mere rank counting.
